description: Route a runtime symptom to candidate record addresses in the CorpusFetch pillar. Returns warrant_url, py_url, md_url, and fetch_when for each candidate. Fetch the warrant first (~220 tokens); if its seal fails, do not fetch the .md.

symptom.description: Runtime symptom key, e.g. UNICODE_HOMOGLYPH_OR_MOJIBAKE, or a DOMAIN_* key

name: corpusfetch_lookup_symptom
